title: Nanoparticle-mediated mitigation of salt stress-induced oxidative damage in plants: insights into signaling, gene expression, and antioxidant mechanisms
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,2983-3017
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00174A, Critical Review
Km Madhuri Singh, Ambuj Bhushan Jha, Rama Shanker Dubey, Pallavi Sharma
Nanoparticles mitigate salt-induced oxidative stress in plants by regulating signaling pathways, gene expression, and antioxidant enzyme activity, enhancing resilience and promoting sustainable crop productivity under salinity stress.
